cohort: Pregnant women aged >=18 years, comprising 52 with pre-eclampsia and 104 without pre-eclampsia, recruited from two referral hospitals in Rwanda.
finding: Periodontitis was significantly associated with pre-eclampsia, with pregnant women with periodontitis being 3.85 times more likely to develop pre-eclampsia.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, with pre-eclampsia diagnosed after 20 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Pre-eclampsia was diagnosed after 20 weeks of gestation.
